observations: Final same-camera front, oblique, side, grazing-light and whole-head views show a slight further lip retreat relative to v18.
No prominent newly introduced vertical grooves, steps or patch boundary were seen in the final inspected images.
The surrounding cheeks, chin and head silhouette remain visually consistent; independent coordinate checks confirm all geometry outside the small lip support unchanged.
Original lip edges and shading remain visible. The effect is deliberately small and should not be described as complete elimination of pouting.

scope: Reviewer wrote only new v19 validation/review files and temporary analysis; v18 and other source models were not modified.
